headline: I Design LinkedIn Brands For The Top Creators.

posts.text:
Today, I'm celebrating my 2-year anniversary on LinkedIn.

I've helped 0 to 50+ clients globally on LinkedIn.

Not because I went viral.

Not because I had thousands of followers.

But because I kept showing up.

Every post taught me something.

Every client taught me even more.

LinkedIn has given me more than clients.

It has given me opportunities, connections, & confidence in my work.

A huge thank you to everyone who has supported me over the last two years. 💜 

To celebrate this milestone, I'm offering a special discount on all my design services.

Need help with any design work?  Just shoot me a DM.

Without branding, no one trusts you.

Here’s why… 👇🏻

Let’s be honest

Most people hesitate to work with you
When your brand looks unclear or unprofessional

→ Your offers get ignored
→ Your audience doesn’t grow
→ Clients ghost you after asking for prices

They don’t take you seriously
They go with someone who “looks” more legit

Why?

Because people judge what they see
long before they believe what you say

No branding means

→ No first impression
→ No authority
→ No trust
→ No sales

In simple words

If you don’t look trustworthy,
People won’t trust you.

But with solid branding…

- You instantly look credible
- People feel safe investing in you
- Your name becomes memorable
- You attract serious buyers

Branding is your shortcut
to trust, authority, and growth.

Build one that works
Because random visuals
will never convince people to choose you.

PS. Need help with brand design? 
DM “ BRAND” let’s talk!

I use 8 tools to dominate LinkedIn.
And they handle 90% of my work.

Most people struggle on LinkedIn, not because 
Of strategy, but because their toolkit is empty.

Here’s the exact toolkit I use to design
High-quality visuals.

1. Figma
- For all my design work

2. Photoshop 
- For design edits and polishing

3. Gemini 
- For ideas and image creation

4. ChatGPT 
- To research and speed up writing

5. Notion
- To keep my clients' projects under control

6. Calendly
- Book and manage calls instantly 

7. Behance
- To update my portfolio & research

8. Pinterest
- Discover my creative fuel station.

Just 8 simple tools that work.
Begin with what you have.

Stay consistent. 
Learn as you go.

P.S. What's your favorite tool for LinkedIn?

How I rebranded Darren's LinkedIn profile.

Most professionals think of LinkedIn.
Success comes from:

- Copy-paste templates
- Generic headshots
- Random posting

Those might get you started.
But they won't make you stand out.

Here's what actually builds AUTHORITY:

1.     Clarity → people understand you fast
2.     Niche → the right people find you
3.     Message → simple, direct, obvious
4.     Differentiation → you don’t blend in
5.     Consistency → people remember you

Before I design anything, I don’t start with visuals.
I start with questions:

→ What’s his niche? 
→ What’s his “why”? 
→ What does he want to achieve?


Strong profiles don't come from fancy templates.
They come from strategic brand thinking.

Looking for Profile Optimization? 
DM the word 'BRAND' to get started.

P.S. I don’t just fix your profile. I build the positioning that gets you noticed, trusted, and paid.

Good design starts with "Why."

Every color, font, and element should have a purpose.

Elements in your designs
It's not just about looking good.

→ It's about why it works.
→ It's about the purpose behind it.
→ It's about the value it adds.

•Research & understand your audience's psychology. 
•Create designs that connect on a deeper level.
•Every element 
•Every visual
•Every color
•Every line

Every element should have a reason
Make every pixel count. 
Start Design with purpose.

P.S.: Repost this ♻️ to help others.
